name: Kawaura Yoshiharu
source:
4 years after the incident in Episode 1, Hal woke up with his life but without his dream. [spoiler] He can't move his left leg and unable to express any facial expressions due to psychological trauma after being tricked by  [url=https://vndb.org/c12777]Barton[/url]. 

He gave up the investment world, earned scholarship in studying laws and now works in a small government office.[/spoiler]
